description: This file defines an enumeration 'Topic' representing different messaging topics used within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It includes methods to retrieve topic names, pub/sub topics, and lookup by name.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Enum representing various messaging topics, each with associated name and pub/sub topic string, used for communication within a connectivitiy context.

methods.name: getPubSubTopic
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub topic string associated with the Topic instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name string of the Topic.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the Topic matching the provided name string; returns empty if no match found.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString to return the topic's name.
